name: Ohio FFA membership through your school chapter
org: Ohio FFA Association (Ohio Department of Education and Workforce)
what_you_do: Join FFA at a school that has an Ohio FFA chapter. Members build leadership and career skills in agriculture and take part in Career Development Events.
who_can_apply: Students at schools with an Ohio FFA chapter. The membership page does not list grades or ages. Ask your chapter advisor.
pay_detail: $17 per member covers State and National FFA dues. The school is invoiced by Ohio FFA. Local chapter dues are not stated.
deadline_text: Membership opens each August through FFA.org. Ohio FFA lists September 30, 2026 for students in Fall CDEs and November 30, 2026 for all chapters.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's FFA chapter advisor to add you. Chapters submit membership through FFA.org. Schools with no program can contact Ohio FFA about starting a chapter.
notes: Not a job. The homepage reports 30,880 members in 345 chapters. State office phone is (614) 387-7575. The September 30 and November 30 dates are chapter deadlines, so a student should ask the advisor early.
